status: User-confirmed Elf event structure and grants; drafted power content; not an executable balanced catalog
definitionAuthority: Seven fixed Elf power definitions and Trishula are here; 36 ranked thematic powers live in universal-power-wheels-design.json and Fire Manipulation in universal-element-wheel-design.json.

orderedPoolContract.order: Holy/Blood retain their twelve-option relative potential order. Cursed universal-power/0.2.0 is twenty outcomes ordered Tier 1–5, four per tier. Display order never replaces the accepted ID-based Archetype decision.
orderedPoolContract.grant: Only the selected outcome is granted; lower-ranked powers are not bundled.
orderedPoolContract.mastery: Potential rank does not set mastery, main stats, Apex Force, or rarity.
orderedPoolContract.weights: User-confirmed equal base weights (1 per eligible option) unless the user specified a distribution; declared eligibility and conditional modifiers are applied before normalization. Strength order is not rarity.

earlyGrantContract.idempotence: The same committed result and component slot applies its grant once; retries do not duplicate an ability, weapon, or Strength bonus.
earlyGrantContract.masteryTiming: Before the normal stages defer all weapon mastery and the single shared Power Mastery. Weapon instances retain their own normal mastery; all power grants share the character mastery record.
earlyGrantContract.mainWheelPolicy: Main weapon and power spins remain. A None result adds nothing and does not delete an earlier grant.
earlyGrantContract.powerGate: Finish main Power acquisition, immediate acquisition events/details and all authorized bonus acquisitions. Check the entire owned power inventory, including racial grants.
earlyGrantContract.weaponGate: At weapon stage, resolve all pending owned weapon masteries including early Trishula even if the main weapon draw adds no weapon.
earlyGrantContract.lateGrant: A late weapon resolves its own authorized mastery/enchantment subflow. A late power inherits shared mastery; if there has never been a mastery spin and the scheduled stage was empty, the first late power opens the one shared draw. Restore the saved caller.
earlyGrantContract.duplicateDefinitionPolicy: Existing instance/provenance rules apply; exact repeated-definition merge or exclusion policy remains pending. Never reroll a committed duplicate result.

strengthBonus.timing: Record the modifier at the race result. Add once to the later rolled base numeric Strength; do not modify or reroll the base result.
strengthBonus.scaleRequirement: Strength needs a numeric value scale or an explicitly declared tier-to-numeric mapping. +1 is not one ordinal tier.

contextContract.coverage: Elf family, all eight type results, all 36 ranked power results, both sea-form results, and all four season results carry context.
contextContract.timing: Apply only the committed result effects, append its factual context, then react using the as-of-result snapshot.
contextContract.fixedGrants: Fixed grants attach context to the type reveal; do not manufacture a separate random wheel or mastery spin at race stage.
contextContract.scope: Traits and powers below describe this game. Research identity themes do not add undeclared racial bonuses.
